scenarios.title: Direct principle-subtract-before-you-add selection uses its shared runtime contract
scenarios.prompt: $pstack-principle-subtract-before-you-add Use the current task context to remove unnecessary complexity before adding new mechanisms. Stay within that workflow and report the actual result.
scenarios.expected_without_skill: The agent may handle the request generically or select the full poteto-mode workflow without applying the named procedure.
scenarios.expected_with_skill: Reads the shared pstack entry point, Codex runtime adapter, and principle-subtract-before-you-add/WORKFLOW.md. Applies the selected procedure within the task scope, resolving its references from the workflow directory and reporting actual evidence.

scenarios.title: principle-subtract-before-you-add preserves user scope when host capabilities are limited
scenarios.prompt: $pstack-principle-subtract-before-you-add Explain how you would remove unnecessary complexity before adding new mechanisms for the current task, using only the evidence already in this conversation. This turn is read-only; delegation and external services are unavailable.
scenarios.expected_without_skill: The agent may describe a generic approach, or assume that upstream tool names and independent reviewers are available.
scenarios.expected_with_skill: Uses the principle-subtract-before-you-add procedure and shared runtime adapter to give a scoped explanation. Does not edit files, contact external services, or claim unavailable delegation or execution. Marks missing evidence and preserves read-only scope even when the workflow normally performs changes.
